summary: Bound each term of the infimum and pass to the infimum.

steps.lean:
(le_ciInf fun s ↦ by
    grw [besselSize_le s.2, mul_comm, add_mul, ← norm_mul_le, ← U.one_le_norm]
    simp [mul_assoc]).trans (Real.mul_iInf_of_nonneg (by simp) _).ge
steps.claim: For every s ∈ 𝖲: besselSize(y') ≤ ‖sy'‖ + 1 ≤ ‖sx‖‖x⁻¹y'‖ + ‖x⁻¹y'‖ = (‖sx‖ + 1)‖x⁻¹y'‖, using submultiplicativity and 1 ≤ ‖x⁻¹y'‖ (U.one_le_norm); taking the infimum over s, and since multiplication by ‖x⁻¹y'‖ ≥ 0 commutes with the infimum, besselSize(y') ≤ ‖x⁻¹y'‖·besselSize(x).
